beats.summary: Martin describes prison life as boring but with outdoor time and classes, including business and art.

evidence.snippet: Martin: Not terrible. Boring. We do the same thing every day. But… at least we got outdoors time.
Martin: They did, taught by some uh, Harvard business school guys–a lot of the guys also, that were in the class, the inmates, a lot of them have gone on to do extraordinary things in business.

beats.summary: Michael reacts to coworkers saying prison sounds better than the office and decides to implement outdoor time at work.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This place is not prison. It's… way better than prison.

beats.summary: Michael leads the office outside for outdoor time despite cold weather, with mixed reactions from coworkers.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Why don't we… pump some iron? Anyone wanna… pump up?
